summary: yum_repository options: owner, password, priority (1-99 with plugin), proxy settings (or _none_), repo_gpgcheck, reposdir, retries, s3_enabled and selevel.
questions: How do I set a proxy for one yum repo?
How do I disable the global proxy for a repo?
How do I set repo priority?
How do I use basic auth for a yum repo?

answer_card.title: yum_repository proxy, priority, auth
answer_card.answer_md:
- `proxy` (`_none_` disables global), `proxy_username`, `proxy_password`
- `priority`: 1–99 (needs priorities plugin)
- `password` (+ `username`)
- `repo_gpgcheck`: verify repodata
- `reposdir` (`/etc/yum.repos.d`)
- `retries` (`0` = forever), `s3_enabled`
